scripts.publish:major: npm --no-git-tag-version version major && rimraf build && npm install && npm run test && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:minor: npm --no-git-tag-version version minor && rimraf build && npm install && npm run test && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:patch: npm --no-git-tag-version version patch && rimraf build && npm install && npm run test && npm publish --access public
